Please add Quinn Holloway (borrower's counsel, her first email is at the very bottom) as Attorney. Blake is already in the CRM.

 

Pat Staffer

Managing Director

Your Company

Your Company Tagline Here

O (555) 010-0100 | M (555) 010-0101

100 Main Street, Anytown, ST 00000

www.yourcompany.com

 

From: Blake Mercer <bmercer@mercerlogistics.example>
Sent: Tuesday, November 10, 2026 9:48 AM
To: Pat Staffer <pat@yourcompany.com>; Quinn Holloway <qholloway@hollowaystrand.example>
Cc: Jess Ibarra <jibarra@hollowaystrand.example>
Subject: RE: Mercer Logistics - fleet refinance documents

 

Pat, Quinn,

 

Confirming we are good with the revised schedule. Our board approved the resolution last night and Jess has the signed copy. Two items from our side: the insurance certificate naming the lender as loss payee will come from our broker by Thursday, and our controller is pulling the last three months of borrowing-base reports so the lender has them before funding.

 

If we can hold the Friday funding date that would be ideal; we have a vendor payment that depends on it.

 

Thanks,

 

Blake Mercer

Chief Financial Officer

Mercer Logistics Inc.

4400 Distribution Parkway, Memphis, TN 38118

Office (901) 555-0137

bmercer@mercerlogistics.example

 

From: Quinn Holloway <qholloway@hollowaystrand.example>
Sent: Monday, November 9, 2026 6:12 PM
To: Blake Mercer <bmercer@mercerlogistics.example>; Pat Staffer <pat@yourcompany.com>
Cc: Jess Ibarra <jibarra@hollowaystrand.example>
Subject: RE: Mercer Logistics - fleet refinance documents

 

All,

 

Attached is the revised schedule of collateral with the twelve units Blake flagged removed and the four replacement units added. Serial numbers now match the titles we received this morning. Jess will circulate a blackline against the lender's last turn.

 

Remaining open points on our side: (1) the guaranty cap language in section 7.3, which we proposed at 50 percent of the outstanding balance; (2) the cross-default threshold, where we asked for 250,000 instead of 100,000; and (3) the reporting covenant, where monthly borrowing-base certificates should be enough given the asset class. None of these should hold up the closing.

 

Quinn

 

Sent from my iPhone

From: Pat Staffer <pat@yourcompany.com>
Sent: Monday, November 9, 2026 2:30 PM
To: Quinn Holloway <qholloway@hollowaystrand.example>; Blake Mercer <bmercer@mercerlogistics.example>
Cc: Jess Ibarra <jibarra@hollowaystrand.example>
Subject: RE: Mercer Logistics - fleet refinance documents

 

Quinn, Blake,

 

Lender has signed off on the term sheet changes. They will accept the 50 percent guaranty cap but want the cross-default at 150,000. Monthly reporting is fine with them as long as the first certificate is delivered at closing. I think that is a fair landing spot and would recommend we take it.

 

Pat

 

From: Jess Ibarra <jibarra@hollowaystrand.example>
Sent: Monday, November 9, 2026 11:05 AM
To: Pat Staffer <pat@yourcompany.com>
Cc: Quinn Holloway <qholloway@hollowaystrand.example>; Blake Mercer <bmercer@mercerlogistics.example>
Subject: RE: Mercer Logistics - fleet refinance documents

 

Good morning Pat,

 

Per Quinn, please find the executed board resolution and the certificate of good standing for Mercer Logistics Inc. We are still waiting on two title certificates from the state, which we expect by Wednesday. I will send them as soon as they arrive.

 

Kind regards,

 

Jess Ibarra

Senior Paralegal

Holloway Strand LLP

Direct (615) 555-0185

Quinn,

 

Twelve of the units on the original schedule were sold in the third quarter, so they need to come off. I have attached the list with the four we bought in September that can replace them. Values on the replacements are slightly higher, so the advance rate should not change. Let me know if the lender needs fresh appraisals on the new units or if the purchase invoices are enough.

 

Blake

 

Blake Mercer

From: Quinn Holloway <qholloway@hollowaystrand.example>
Sent: Friday, November 6, 2026 10:20 AM
To: Pat Staffer <pat@yourcompany.com>
Cc: Blake Mercer <bmercer@mercerlogistics.example>
Subject: RE: Mercer Logistics - fleet refinance documents

 

Pat,

 

Thanks for the quick turn. We reviewed the lender's draft loan and security agreement over the last two days. The document is generally in good shape. Our main comments go to the guaranty, the cross-default threshold, reporting, and the collateral schedule, which still lists units the company no longer owns. Blake will send an updated list. We would like to keep the closing on track for the end of next week.

 

Quinn
